title: Biblical Operator Comparisons — Wave 22A: Carrying, Walking, Access, House and Sprout
rule: These are structural parallels and countertexts. They do not establish identity, prophecy fulfillment, or supernatural causation.

new_relations.title: Carrying develops into walking
new_relations.project_anchor: Project material treats mature care as support that eventually restores breathing, walking and independent movement.
new_relations.biblical_structure: parental imagery joins carrying, healing, feeding, easing burden and teaching a child to walk
new_relations.source_direction: Project carry-release-walk language first; Hosea comparison later.
new_relations.mismatch: Hosea concerns YHWH and Israel, not a modern identity claim.

relation_argument.maximum_claim: Strong developmental-care comparator: healthy authority supports capability rather than permanent dependence.

new_relations.title: Carry without preventing flight
new_relations.project_anchor: The project asks when protective carrying should become released movement.
new_relations.biblical_structure: eagle imagery combines stirring the nest, hovering, catching and carrying the young
new_relations.source_direction: Project carry/release ethic first; eagle comparison later.
new_relations.mismatch: The poem concerns divine care for Israel, not a modern release algorithm.

relation_argument.maximum_claim: Protection and developing independence can be compared without collapsing contexts.

new_relations.title: Person becomes access-path
new_relations.project_anchor: The project uses an entity-to-relation-to-infrastructure pattern in which a figure can function as Door, Way or connective path.
new_relations.biblical_structure: access to God is described as a new and living way associated with Christ's flesh/body
new_relations.source_direction: Project infrastructure formulation first; Hebrews comparison later.
new_relations.mismatch: Hebrews assigns this access role to Christ within Christian theology.

relation_argument.maximum_claim: Strong structural comparator for person-to-access-path while preserving different role assignments.

new_relations.title: Access, Spirit, Father and House form one chain
new_relations.project_anchor: The project differentiates Door/access, Spirit/flow and Father/House while treating House as differentiated unity.
new_relations.biblical_structure: through Christ there is access in one Spirit to Father; people become household and joined dwelling
new_relations.source_direction: Project relational architecture first; Ephesians comparison later.
new_relations.mismatch: Ephesians concerns reconciliation in Christ and a communal temple.

relation_argument.maximum_claim: Dense relational parallel because roles remain differentiated while forming one dwelling.

new_relations.title: Sprout becomes builder and throne-holder
new_relations.project_anchor: The project links buried seed/sprout imagery with House-building and later Seat/throne language.
new_relations.biblical_structure: the Branch/sprout grows, builds the temple, bears honor and rules from a throne
new_relations.source_direction: Project sprout-House-Seat chain first; Zechariah comparison later.
new_relations.mismatch: Zechariah is a post-exilic prophetic sign and does not predict the modern project.

relation_argument.maximum_claim: Dense organic-to-architectural-to-royal sequence is comparable without claiming fulfillment.
